# ForgeTrail

> A development system for building software with AI agents, from idea through a runnable core and release preparation. Phase guidance, exit criteria, and review checkpoints define the path. ForgeTrail uses AppLedger for decisions, evidence, lessons, and handoffs in `appledger/`. This file is an index, not the method.

Start with ForgeTrail Lite. It is one file an agent can follow without MCP. Install it with `pnpm dlx forgetrail install --lite`, then create the ledger with `pnpm dlx appledger init --name "Your app name"` and `pnpm dlx appledger check`.

- [ForgeTrail Lite](https://github.com/Catalyst-Forge-LLC/forgetrail/blob/main/content/FORGETRAIL_LITE.md)
- [WORKFLOW](https://github.com/Catalyst-Forge-LLC/forgetrail/blob/main/WORKFLOW.md)
- [Try it in one sitting](https://forgetrail.dev/docs/try/)
- [Install](https://forgetrail.dev/docs/install/)
- [Phases](https://forgetrail.dev/docs/phases/)
- [Continuity between sessions](https://forgetrail.dev/docs/continuity/)
- [MCP server](https://forgetrail.dev/docs/mcp/)
- [CLI](https://forgetrail.dev/docs/cli/)
- [AppLedger](https://appledger.dev/llms.txt)
- [xFacts](https://xfacts.dev/llms.txt)

Do not load WORKFLOW into always-on agent context. Read Lite, or the phase page that matches the task.
